name: darcy
_comment: PDEBench 2D Darcy flow, -div(a grad u) = beta with u = 0 on the boundary, in one .npz: X (N, 16384) = coefficient a, Y (N, 16384) = u, each a flattened 128 x 128 field. beta (the uniform source) is read from the file name (darcy_beta1.0_...). Cell-centred grid, so the unit-square spacing is taken as 1/128 (irrelevant to the R^2 of F008).
